risks.risk: Microwave may not heat properly (magnetron/transformer issue) even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: A short video of the microwave running with a cup of water (or a heating test) showing time countdown and steam/boiling after a set time.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: treat as needing repair/unknown performance).

risks.risk: Grill function may not work (heater element faulty or not heating).
risks.proof: A short video of the grill mode running (or grill heating test) with the grill indicator on and visible heat/consistent browning on food.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as microwave-only / grill not working (worst case: grill untested or not working).

risks.risk: Door seal/latch may be weak, causing leakage or failure to start.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the door latch/hinge area plus a test showing it starts reliably and stays running; ideally a microwave leakage test is not possible remotely, but reliable start is key.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potential door/latch issue (worst case: may not start reliably).

risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate/label (inside door frame or back) showing brand, model, and voltage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the generic worst-case for an unverified microwave/grill unit.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the rating plate/label (brand, model, voltage) on the microwave.
Send a short video showing microwave mode running (time countdown) with a heating test (e.g., water steams/boils).
Send a short video showing grill mode running and a simple browning/heating result.
